answers.core: As above, it's a really small quality-of-life improvement and likely no one would care if it's in asset lib.
answers.workaround: An editor plugin could be written to achieve the functionality, but it's too small a feature to worth people's time downloading it. A straight-forward implementation might be simply parsing gdscript and checking setter's lvalue.
